Introduction

Yoon Jiyoon is a South Korean singer under WAKEONE.

In 2024, she was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she ended up ranking 3rd place in the final with 471,699 votes, thus securing her spot as a member of the final group, izna.

Yoon Jiyoon made her debut with the group on November 25, 2024, with the release of their first mini album titled "N/a".

On February 19, 2025, it was announced by WAKEONE that she would be taking a break for an undetermined time due to health issues. On August 19, 2025, it was reported that she would be leaving the group.
